author: Mahesh Marathe
affiliation: A. P. Shah Institute of Technology, Thane
primary_dataset: Official prepared CADETS E3; existing split and conservative node labels
disclosure: Retrospective benchmark: seed-0 V3/ORTHRUS test results were inspected before this plan. No claim of an untouched external test set.
primary_threshold: Existing benign-only relation calibration and node-window evidence; false_alert_rate=0.001; unchanged across arms
selection: First validation third: minimum relation cross entropy. Remaining validation thirds: score calibration and threshold. No test-label model/threshold selection.
candidate: V3 with attention-only short-memory readout; original active-window CNN and affine endpoint memory retained. Chosen for previously measured compute reduction, before candidate accuracy is inspected.
budget_policy: Sum of per-call GPU timeouts reserved before launch must stay <=28800 seconds. No automatic retries. Timed-out or failed jobs are recorded, not invented or silently replaced. CPU preparation/document building is outside the GPU-hour limit.
comparison_limits: GNN baseline is a disclosed causal GraphSAGE edge-reconstruction baseline, not an exact reproduction of the Wazuh supervised continual learner.

KAIROS is directly run with authors-traced neural modules, hierarchical hashing and the shared ten-relation CADETS vocabulary; node scoring is adapted to the common protocol. Full native queue/attack reconstruction is not equivalent to this detector-level comparison.
Twenty-epoch ORTHRUS and fifty-epoch KAIROS checks address unequal released training budgets; any incomplete run is explicitly reported.
Additional datasets, five-seed Wazuh reproduction, attribution quality, end-to-end capture costs and prospective deployment remain gaps unless independently completed.
